definition: A class of reinforcement learning algorithms that directly optimize a parameterized policy by estimating the gradient of expected reward with respect to policy parameters.
details: Policy gradient methods, including PPO, are widely used in RLHF pipelines to fine-tune language models based on reward signals derived from human preference data.
story: Imagine a video game where the only feedback is the score ticking up or down — and you learn by playing a million rounds. Boil it down and it is this: A class of reinforcement learning algorithms that directly optimize a parameterized policy by estimating the gradient of expected reward with respect to policy parameters. Here is why it matters: Policy gradient methods, including PPO, are widely used in RLHF pipelines to fine-tune language models based on reward signals derived from human preference data. Reward, not instructions, is the teacher. That learn-by-reward loop is Policy Gradient.
